The skill bundle is a purely descriptive tool for self-reflection on generosity practices. The Python code in handler.py is safe, performing basic string matching and JSON formatting without any file system access, network calls, or dangerous execution functions. The SKILL.md file contains educational content and does not include any prompt-injection attempts or instructions to bypass safety filters.

llm.guidance: This skill appears internally consistent and low-risk: it only processes the text you give it and returns JSON recommendations with no network calls or credential access. The included Python handler is simple and self-contained; the odd repeated string-equality branches (comparing the skill slug to other skill names) look like harmless dead code or a reused template and are a code-quality issue rather than a security problem. If you plan to deploy broadly or use with sensitive user data, review for privacy compliance and consider conducting a code review, but there are no immediate red flags preventing normal use.
